results.title: Sugar
results.overview: Oscar, a young sex worker, spends the night with an older client who introduces him to GHB and promises care. As the drug takes hold, reality fractures and the bathroom transforms—until the night turns dangerous.

results.title: Kind Procedures
results.overview: An ironic portrait of fascism that uses archival footage of a pig slaughter to reduce the "Great Leader" to his ultimate truth: dead weight.

results.title: Five Years, Four Months
results.overview: Martha (45), a mother who lost track of her son due to the conflict, receives the news that there was no bone concordance in the last exhumation she participated in. Exhausted of the institutional channels, she turns to a group of women searchers and meets Sandra, who tells her a rumor: “in a remote village on the flatlands of Colombia, you can request a favour from a dead person”. Together with Sandra, they embark on a journey in search of answers, blurring the line between the living and the dead. Mothers searching for their children, children searching for their mothers: two sides of the same scourge converge in search of peace.

results.title: The Reunion: Laguna Beach
results.overview: For the first time in 20 years, original Laguna Beach cast members Lauren Conrad, Stephen Colletti, Kristin Cavallari, Trey Phillips, Talan Torriero, Christina Schuller, Lo Bosworth, Dieter Schmitz, Jessica Smith, Alex Hooser, and Morgan Olsen reunite to relive moments from the show that shaped a generation. Featuring behind-the-scenes stories, cast reactions to iconic episodes, and a return to Laguna Beach, they reflect on the friendships, love triangles, and drama that changed their lives.

results.title: Spore
results.overview: Four scientists investigate a deadly fungus in the mountains. When one of them becomes infected, their sampling mission becomes a struggle to prevent the infected host from escaping.

results.title: The Cure - Maia North Festival 2026
results.overview: The Cure Headline 2026 Maia North Festival

results.title: The Curtain Call
results.overview: After becoming involved in the murder of a paparazzo, rising actor Harrison Monroe and kingpin talk show host Jackson Harper clash in the underbelly of Hollywood. In pursuit of fame, Harrison must navigate truth, betrayal, and manipulation—all while appearing as a guest on Jackson’s late night talk show.

results.title: Children Untold
results.original_title: わたしの知らない子どもたち
results.overview: War may be over, but for the children of Miwa Nishikawa’s latest film — adapted from her forthcoming novel — survival has only begun.

results.title: Home Not Alone 3
results.overview: Masha encounters the insidious Nyanya again. But now the villain has a new ally - the charming swindler Anton. At stake is the school graduation. Together with her friend Egor, Masha must stop the criminals and save the most important evening of the year.

results.title: Tokyo MER: Mobile Emergency Room - Capital Crisis
results.original_title: 劇場版TOKYO MER〜走る緊急救命室〜CAPITAL CRISIS

results.title: The Liar's Circle
results.overview: Cecilia arrives in Guadalajara for the first time to study at the Faculty of Literature and become a writer. There she meets Nicolás and Aristeo, young men who claim to be the founders—though in reality the only members—of the Underground Ultraism, a literary movement that aims to change Mexican literature. Through them, she meets Pita, an irreverent and openly bisexual poet with whom she forms a genuine bond. Cecilia finds a new sense of belonging in this group, until the friendship holding it together begins to fracture under the weight of envy.

results.title: Still Water
results.overview: In 2008, as China basks in Olympic glory, Xi, a domestic worker, remains haunted by the loss of her sister in a devastating earthquake. When she learns of her sister’s reincarnation, she becomes drawn to her employer’s unborn child, convinced it is her sister.

results.title: What is the matter?
results.overview: Four couples. One night that was supposed to be perfect… but everything turned into chaos. Between expectations, pressure, and inexperience, every story takes an unexpected turn. Awkward situations, wrong decisions, and endless disasters…

results.title: Slush
results.overview: Riga isn’t necessarily beautiful in winter. But it is alive. Kārlis accidentally runs over Kirils, breaking his bicycle. To fix it, they set out together to find a repairman – who, of course, has disappeared somewhere. One coincidence follows another, one encounter leads to the next, and their seemingly aimless wandering through Riga gradually turns into a friendship. It is a symphony of youth played out amidst falling snow, the noise of traffic, the voices of the city and improvised music. Carpe diem – they seize the day.

results.title: Bisikan Nafsu
results.overview: UR is a famous Romantic Ustaz who is married to Alyssa who has a daughter named Nadia. Unbeknownst to Alyssa, UR is apparently a playboy. In secret, UR has also had a relationship with Alyssa's best friend, Aida. Alyssa caught UR with Aida, but due to their boundless love, Alyssa has forgiven UR and is still faithful to each other.

results.title: Ego Raman
results.overview: Follows the toxic relationship between a prospective civil servant and a conceited school principal, which intensifies when a Yamaha motorbike enters the narrative.

results.title: The Nose - A Fading Case
results.original_title: Die Nase - Ein Fall aus dem Nichts
results.overview: One morning, Bernhard wakes up without his nose. When his wife Sabine notices that other objects around the house have gone missing too, she starts her own investigation, trying to make sense of the strange events. Bernhard, meanwhile, turns his gaze outward, following an uncertain trail into the night sky that only he seems to see. In a web of red thread, blinking lights, and flickering stars, the two search, each in their own way, for an answer to the inexplicable  disappearance of their world.

results.title: No Evidence of Man
results.overview: In the wake of a crushing breakup from his long-time girlfriend, Peter escapes to the mountains to cleanse his spiritual palette.

results.title: Smoked Too
results.overview: The stoners are back. Broke and desperate, these idiots rob a Marijuana club, not knowing this club is owned by crack kingpin, Shank who dispatches the feared killers - "The Four Horseman" to kill them. This pursuit sends a wave of violence across Oakland killing Hippies, Ninjas, Naked Clowns and just about anyone in the way.
